text_block_list.text:
"Steadily continuing to run in races,
Oguri Cap's true strength was now plain for all to see!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, sorry to keep you waiting.
Well then, shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Oguri Cap!
She's been working really hard lately, hasn't she!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's really building up her strength.
Man, it's finally almost time...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...It kind of feels like people are talking about me.
choice_data_list: Everyone's got their eyes on Oguri.
Everyone's got their eyes on Oguri, you know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see...
I've started gaining confidence too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Running in lots of races and gaining experience...
It seems I've grown stronger too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So...
Which race should I run next?

Every eye in the venue turned toward Oguri Cap.
With the track record she had built up to this point,
there was obviously only one path forward for her.
choice_data_list: Will you run in a GⅠ?
Will you run in a GⅠ?

text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ race. A special race for both the Umamusume
running in it and the spectators watching.
A victory here leads directly to glory.

With how she is now, Oguri Cap...
can take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ race...
I see, understood.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"No... I think running in big races
would make it easier for my name to reach the folks back home."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What I need to do remains the same, however.
I simply have to show everyone what it looks like to win.

I know that Oguri Cap's motivation
comes from the folks back home.

However, that alone won't be enough to win through the GⅠs.
It is vital to look ahead and set high goals.

For that to happen, Oguri Cap herself needs to set her sights higher.
Which means—
choice_data_list: Next time, I'm gonna go watch that race!
Let's go watch that race next time!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That race...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~, who's gonna take it this year?
I'm so excited~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
You really gotta root for the girl you voted for!
The final big race of the year! Do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... What incredible enthusiasm.
So this is the 'Arima Kinen'...

The "Arima Kinen." A grand race where
umamusume chosen by fan votes compete,
serving as the year's ultimate finale.

That sheer frenzy is top-class
among all races. I'm sure Oguri Cap
will feel something from it too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Looks like it's starting.
Why am I getting so nervous...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAH......!!!)

—The "Arima Kinen" that day
reached the highest peak of excitement I had ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
"Man... that was amazing!
I'm honestly so moved..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh! She won the Grand Prix!
I'm so glad I never gave up cheering for her...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"No...
My chest just feels warm, somehow."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
After experiencing that level for the first time upon arriving at the Central.
After winning my debut race... It's completely different from any of those.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer.
I...—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that girl Oguri Cap?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're right, Oguri is over there!
Heyyy!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching your recent performances!
I'm rooting for you, you know!

text_block_list.name: Spectator G
text_block_list.text:
Watching your races
always gets me so excited!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text: I'm voting for you in the next Arima Kinen! You've definitely got to run!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...!
Ah... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you...!

Basking in the immense cheers from the crowd,
Oguri Cap seemed to resolve herself toward something.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, people in the JRA
had started cheering for me too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those cheers... makes me want to run.
I want the folks back home to see me running here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I... I want to run in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...So, what's your ultimate goal?
What kind of races do you want to run in?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh... That's...
...

Oguri Cap didn't have a target race.
Yet now, there is an unmistakable determination in her eyes. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yeah!
—And so, with our sights set on next year's Arima Kinen, our days of training alongside Oguri Cap began anew!
